criteria.evidence: The sentence "In one closely comparable prior case, an $18,000.00 promotion-markdown demand was denied while a commercial freight refund was approved, and combined damage-plus-delay claims on this carrier generally pay the damage component near invoice value while excluding the delay component [HC-2025-0094][F-225]" is unsupported: F-224 (not F-225) lists HC-2025-0094 as one of three rows in the DELAY-ONLY cohort, while F-225's damage-plus-delay cohort is actually composed of HC-2025-0142 and HC-2024-0218 — HC-2025-0094 does not belong to it. No referenced fact anywhere gives HC-2025-0094's specific dollar amounts or outcome ($18,000 markdown denied / freight refund approved), so those specifics are fabricated and attached to the wrong comp figure.

Missing/open items are consistently hedged as currently unresolved rather than final: "the vendor packaging specification you requested is not currently available on our side" and "we're confirming internally whether that work was performed by a third party and will follow up with documentation"; the freight ask is framed as a request ("ask BlueLine to reconsider... as a commercial gesture"), not a claimed entitlement, consistent with its GOODWILL_LEVER classification.

The draft reply's itemization ($7,225 offer + $2,125 disputed damage + $420 inspection + $300 repack + $1,850 freight goodwill = $11,920) matches position.recommended_counter (F-217) and its core_high/goodwill_high components (F-215/F-216) exactly, the $18,000 markdown is explicitly withdrawn per E-6, and the freight line is explicitly called a "commercial gesture," matching its GOODWILL_LEVER classification (E-7).

The claim "combined damage-plus-delay claims on this carrier generally pay the damage component near invoice value while excluding the delay component [HC-2025-0094][F-225]" states a specific internal settlement-composition pattern as established fact, but F-225 only provides an aggregate 49.93% median across 2 cases with no line-item breakdown to support that granular characterization — this is speculation dressed as settled precedent.

All five material items are covered somewhere in the brief: disputed damaged units (negotiation_analysis para 2, E-3), markdown exclusion (para 3, E-6), EDI-vs-POD conflict (recommended_next_steps action 6, risks_and_watchouts, draft_reply piece-count paragraph), freight-refund goodwill angle (para 3, draft_reply), and evidence gaps G-01 through G-04 (recommended_next_steps, risks_and_watchouts).
